svg.title: Dropdown Menu row variants
svg.desc: The menu enters once with a fade, scale, and blur anchored to its trigger. A three-dot parent trigger opens a menu with a highlighted Profile action and keyboard shortcut, disabled Billing action, checked Show toolbar checkbox, a loading action labeled Saving with a radial spinner, selected System theme radio, unselected Light theme radio, and Transfer submenu. The component uses neutral gray tones with blue measurement guides. Two dividers separate the row groups. The chosen panel width is 224 pixels, rows are 28 pixels high, and the menu opens 6 pixels below its trigger. Drawn at three times CSS size.
